+"""Load images without making requests to user-supplied URLs."""
+import base64
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(value: str) -> bytes | None:
+    if not value or not isinstance(value, str):
+        return None
+    try:
+        if value.startswith("data:image/"):
+            header, encoded = value.split(",", 1)
+            if not header.lower().endswith(";base64"):
+                return None
+            return base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
+
+        parsed = urlsplit(value)
+        if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc:
+            host = urlsplit(settings.STORAGE_HOST)
+            if (parsed.scheme.lower() not in ("http", "https")
+                    or parsed.scheme.lower() != host.scheme.lower()
+                    or parsed.netloc.lower() != host.netloc.lower()
+                    or parsed.username is not None or parsed.password is not None
+                    or parsed.query or parsed.fragment):
+                return None
+            prefix = host.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+            if not parsed.path.startswith(prefix):
+                return None
+            key = unquote(parsed.path[len(prefix):])
+        else:
+            if parsed.query or parsed.fragment or value.startswith("/"):
+                return None
+            key = unquote(parsed.path)
+
+        if (not key or "\\" in key or any(ord(c) < 32 for c in key)
+                or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/"))):
+            return None
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception:
+        return None
